deo.line: Tuigim Mam nach mbeidh tú ar ais go deo
deo.linePrev: Bhí mé ag iarraidh slán a fhágáil, not an Irish goodbye
deo.lineNext: Ach cluinimse do chonsairtín go fóill ag bualadh ceoil

galileo.line: I call on the resting soul of Galileo
stanza: How long 'til my soul gets it right?
Can any human being ever reach that kind of light?
I call on the resting soul of Galileo
King of night vision, king of insight
